hook: The largest sunflower-free family of triples with 4 petals has span 39, cutting a bound from 162 to 130
summary: A sunflower-free system is a family of sets with no r sets sharing a common core and otherwise disjoint. The author constructs the largest such system of 3-element sets with no 4-flower in which every ground element is used, showing the maximum span is 39. This lowers the upper bound f(3,4) from the Erdos-Rado 162 to 130. The result covers only the single case k=3, r=4.
title: The Largest Ground Set for Sunflower-Free Systems
